trap.label: verbo + -ing / have + pp
trap.wrong: I enjoy to cook, avoid to be late and I had repaired my car.
trap.right: I enjoy cooking, avoid being late, and I had my car repaired.
trap.why: Revisão: em português infinitivo após gostar/evitar e “consertei meu carro” mistura quem faz. Em inglês, enjoy/avoid + -ing; have + obj + pp.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com mind: “Is it a problem for you to wait?” (Do you mind...)
Reescreva com have: “Someone fixed my phone.”
Reescreva: “Ana didn’t do it. It is impossible.”
